title: Implement gossipsub tip publish after successful POST
description:
After successful log append, publish a TipAdvertisement for each affected group over gossipsub. If gossipsub publish fails, log a warning but still return 240 (article is stored; propagation is best-effort). Artifact: integrated into reader/src/post/pipeline.rs.

Acceptance:
- Successful POST triggers gossipsub publish for each group in Newsgroups:
- Gossipsub publish failure does not cause POST to fail (return 240 anyway)
- Published TipAdvertisement contains the new tip CID
- Integration test: POST via reader, verify transit peer receives tip advertisement
